mission_10: Magnificent! You have completed the most rigorous approach to evaluating imputation strategies: measuring their impact on downstream model performance. By wrapping each imputation method in a Pipeline with a classifier and evaluating via cross-validation, you obtained objective, comparable scores that reflect real-world utility. This methodology reveals that the best imputation strategy depends on the specific dataset, missingness pattern, and modeling task. Sometimes simple mean imputation performs nearly as well as sophisticated MICE, especially with robust models like Random Forests. The key insight is that imputation should be evaluated not in isolation but as part of the complete ML pipeline. This mission completes your mastery of missing data handling, from basic imputation to advanced evaluation methodologies!
